title: Trading into a won ending
line: When ahead, trade pieces, not pawns.

steps.text: White is a pawn up. With the rooks on, Black's rook can harass the pawns. Without them, the extra pawn decides.
So when you are ahead, trade pieces. Every trade makes your extra pawn count for more.

steps.hint: The rooks face each other on the open file.
steps.after: Only kings and pawns are left, and your pawn on the edge is passed.

steps.text: Now lead with the king: step in front of your passed pawn.

also.c4c5: That works too: the king goes up beside the pawn. This lesson steps in front of it.
also.h2h4: That works too. This lesson brings the king up first.

steps.hint: The square just in front of the pawn.
steps.after: The king leads and the pawn follows, and the black king is too far away.

summary: When you are ahead, trade pieces, not pawns. The fewer pieces left, the more an extra pawn counts.
